title: 社區雨水滲透設施~Neighborhood stormwater infiltration systems
focus: 社區入滲的地層、地下水與事件調蓄~Stratigraphy, groundwater and event storage for community infiltration
summary: 以「社區入滲的地層、地下水與事件調蓄」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow stratigraphy, groundwater and event storage for community infiltration through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 集水組成與逕流~Catchment composition and runoff
units.mechanism: 屋頂、道路和草地具有不同截留與污染來源，先分區再合成。~Roofs, roads and lawns have different interception and pollutant sources; combine only after separate accounting.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：effective area=sum(C A);0.9*600+0.3*400；計算 0.9*600+0.3*400 = 660 m2。適用限制：固定事件係數的教學估算。~Original hypothetical teaching example: effective area=sum(C A);0.9*600+0.3*400; calculation 0.9*600+0.3*400 = 660 m2. Applicability: Teaching estimate with fixed event coefficients.
units.verify: 把100m2草地改成鋪面並重算有效面積。~Convert100m2 of lawn to pavement and recalculate effective area.
units.failure: 土地使用變更而不更新集水資料會低估水量。~Unupdated land-use changes understate runoff.
units.misconception: 社區面積不變就代表逕流永遠不變。~An unchanged community area means unchanged runoff.
units.practice: 在「集水組成與逕流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 660 m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「土地使用變更而不更新集水資料會低估水量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for catchment composition and runoff, first reproduce 660 m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unupdated land-use changes understate runoff." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 入滲量與儲存需求~Infiltration and storage demand
units.mechanism: 雨期進流與可入滲量差值形成儲存需求；不能只比較日總量。~The difference between inflow and infiltration during rain creates storage demand; daily totals alone are insufficient.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：storage=Vin-f A t;Vin=30;f=0.01;A=100;t=2 h；計算 30-0.01*100*2 = 28 m3。適用限制：均勻入滲、單場雨。~Original hypothetical teaching example: storage=Vin-f A t;Vin=30;f=0.01;A=100;t=2 h; calculation 30-0.01*100*2 = 28 m3. Applicability: Uniform infiltration during one storm.
units.verify: 比較同總雨量的短強雨和長弱雨。~Compare short intense and long weak storms with equal totals.
units.failure: 日入滲能力足夠仍可能在短強雨溢流。~Adequate daily capacity can still overflow in a short intense storm.
units.misconception: 日總雨量小於日入滲量就絕不會溢流。~Daily rain below daily infiltration guarantees no overflow.
units.practice: 在「入滲量與儲存需求」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 28 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「日入滲能力足夠仍可能在短強雨溢流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for infiltration and storage demand, first reproduce 28 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adequate daily capacity can still overflow in a short intense storm." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 地層調查與最慢層~Stratigraphy and the limiting layer
units.mechanism: 薄低滲層可能支配垂向排水；需把孔隙、滲透與污染背景放在同一剖面。~A thin low-permeability layer may control vertical drainage; map pores, conductivity and contamination on one section.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：R=sum(L/K);0.2/0.02+0.1/0.001；計算 0.2/0.02+0.1/0.001 = 110 h。適用限制：一維飽和串聯阻力。~Original hypothetical teaching example: R=sum(L/K);0.2/0.02+0.1/0.001; calculation 0.2/0.02+0.1/0.001 = 110 h. Applicability: One-dimensional saturated series resistance.
units.verify: 移除或加厚低滲層，比較等效阻力。~Remove or thicken the low-permeability layer and compare resistance.
units.failure: 只做淺表試驗會漏掉深處限制。~Shallow testing misses deeper constraints.
units.misconception: 表層土壤可代表所有深度地層。~Surface soil represents all depths.
units.practice: 在「地層調查與最慢層」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 110 h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只做淺表試驗會漏掉深處限制。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for stratigraphy and the limiting layer, first reproduce 110 h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Shallow testing misses deeper constraints." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 地下水距離與水丘~Groundwater separation and mounding
units.mechanism: 入滲會改變地下水位；原始距離不等於暴雨後的有效距離。~Infiltration can raise groundwater; initial separation differs from post-storm separation.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：remaining separation=initial-rise;2.0-0.6；計算 2.0-0.6 = 1.4 m。適用限制：假想已計算水丘高度，不是通用允收距離。~Original hypothetical teaching example: remaining separation=initial-rise;2.0-0.6; calculation 2.0-0.6 = 1.4 m. Applicability: Assumed modeled mound, not a universal acceptance distance.
units.verify: 比較乾季與濕季地下水位並記錄基準高程。~Compare dry- and wet-season levels with a common datum.
units.failure: 用最低季節水位會高估安全間距。~Using the seasonal minimum overstates separation.
units.misconception: 地下水位在入滲過程中永遠不變。~Groundwater level never changes during infiltration.
units.practice: 在「地下水距離與水丘」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.4 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用最低季節水位會高估安全間距。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for groundwater separation and mounding, first reproduce 1.4 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using the seasonal minimum overstates separation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 前處理與堵塞負荷~Pretreatment and clogging load
units.mechanism: 沉砂或植生前處理降低顆粒入滲負荷，但需有可清理入口。~Sedimentation or vegetated pretreatment reduces particle loading and needs accessible cleaning.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：remaining solids=M(1-eta);M=20 kg;eta=0.7；計算 20*(1-0.7) = 6 kg/event。適用限制：固定去除率示例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: remaining solids=M(1-eta);M=20 kg;eta=0.7; calculation 20*(1-0.7) = 6 kg/event. Applicability: Fixed-removal illustration.
units.verify: 把前池去除率由0.7降到0.4，估入滲床負荷。~Reduce forebay removal from0.7 to0.4 and estimate bed loading.
units.failure: 前處理滿載會加速入滲面堵塞。~A full pretreatment unit accelerates infiltration-surface clogging.
units.misconception: 前處理去除率不需隨維護狀態改變。~Pretreatment removal is independent of maintenance.
units.practice: 在「前處理與堵塞負荷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 kg/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「前處理滿載會加速入滲面堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pretreatment and clogging load, first reproduce 6 kg/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A full pretreatment unit accelerates infiltration-surface clogging." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 入滲溝空隙容量~Trench void storage
units.mechanism: 碎石與模組儲水的有效孔隙不同，設計帳目需使用實際可用水體積。~Aggregate and modular storage have different usable porosity; account for actual water volume.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=L W D n;L=20;W=2;D=1;n=0.35；計算 20*2*1*0.35 = 14 m3。適用限制：未扣管件與既有水量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=L W D n;L=20;W=2;D=1;n=0.35; calculation 20*2*1*0.35 = 14 m3. Applicability: Excludes fittings and antecedent water occupancy.
units.verify: 比較相同開挖體積兩種孔隙率。~Compare two porosities at equal excavation volume.
units.failure: 把總挖方當儲水量會放大容量。~Using excavation volume exaggerates storage.
units.misconception: 碎石溝體積等於可儲水體積。~Aggregate-trench volume equals water-storage volume.
units.practice: 在「入滲溝空隙容量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 14 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總挖方當儲水量會放大容量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for trench void storage, first reproduce 14 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using excavation volume exaggerates storage." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 污染場址與入滲限制~Contaminated sites and infiltration limits
units.mechanism: 入滲可能推動既有污染遷移；先建立污染概念模型，再決定是否適合入滲。~Infiltration may mobilize existing contamination; develop a conceptual site model before deciding suitability.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：travel time=L/v;L=3 m;v=0.05 m/day；計算 3/0.05 = 60 day。適用限制：不含吸附和降解的平流示意。~Original hypothetical teaching example: travel time=L/v;L=3 m;v=0.05 m/day; calculation 3/0.05 = 60 day. Applicability: Advection illustration without sorption or decay.
units.verify: 比較清潔回填與污染層兩種流路。~Compare flow paths through clean fill and a contaminated layer.
units.failure: 把雨水乾淨當成地下環境也乾淨會漏掉污染源。~Clean rain does not imply clean subsurface conditions.
units.misconception: 任何棕地都適合直接增加入滲。~Every brownfield is suitable for increased infiltration.
units.practice: 在「污染場址與入滲限制」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把雨水乾淨當成地下環境也乾淨會漏掉污染源。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for contaminated sites and infiltration limits, first reproduce 60 day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Clean rain does not imply clean subsurface conditions." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 溢流路線與串聯系統~Overflow routes and linked systems
units.mechanism: 設施滿水時，溢流應導向可承受的路徑；多設施串接需要考慮同時滿載。~When storage fills, overflow needs an appropriate route; linked systems can fill simultaneously.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：residual=Vstorm-Vstore-Vinf;50-28-10；計算 50-28-10 = 12 m3。適用限制：事件桶模型，未含下游回水。~Original hypothetical teaching example: residual=Vstorm-Vstore-Vinf;50-28-10; calculation 50-28-10 = 12 m3. Applicability: Event bucket model without downstream backwater.
units.verify: 模擬兩座設施同時滿水，追蹤最後溢流。~Fill two facilities simultaneously and trace final overflow.
units.failure: 只假設下一座永遠有空間會低估總風險。~Assuming downstream storage is always empty understates risk.
units.misconception: 串接越多座就不可能發生溢流。~More facilities in series make overflow impossible.
units.practice: 在「溢流路線與串聯系統」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 12 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只假設下一座永遠有空間會低估總風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for overflow routes and linked systems, first reproduce 12 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assuming downstream storage is always empty understates risk." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 觀測井與退水診斷~Observation wells and drawdown diagnosis
units.mechanism: 內部水位能看出表面看不到的飽和與底部排水狀態。~Internal water levels reveal saturation and drainage hidden below the surface.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：drawdown rate=(h1-h2)/dt;(0.8-0.2)/12；計算 (0.8-0.2)/12 = 0.05 m/h。適用限制：兩點平均下降速率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: drawdown rate=(h1-h2)/dt;(0.8-0.2)/12; calculation (0.8-0.2)/12 = 0.05 m/h. Applicability: Two-point mean drawdown rate.
units.verify: 以連續水位比較線性、指數與尾端緩慢退水。~Compare linear, exponential and slow-tail drawdown shapes.
units.failure: 表面無水就停止觀測可能錯過底層長期飽和。~Stopping when the surface dries misses persistent lower saturation.
units.misconception: 地表乾燥必定代表入滲溝已完全排空。~A dry surface means the trench is completely empty.
units.practice: 在「觀測井與退水診斷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 m/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「表面無水就停止觀測可能錯過底層長期飽和。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for observation wells and drawdown diagnosis, first reproduce 0.05 m/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Stopping when the surface dries misses persistent lower saturation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 多目標維護與居民介面~Maintenance and community interface
units.mechanism: 入滲、環境品質與公共使用需共同驗收；維護資料應能讓居民理解預期功能。~Review infiltration, environmental quality and public use together; maintenance records should explain intended functions.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：maintenance coverage=completed tasks/planned;9/12；計算 9/12 = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：工作完成度不代表所有性能達標。~Original hypothetical teaching example: maintenance coverage=completed tasks/planned;9/12; calculation 9/12 = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Task completion does not prove all performance targets.
units.verify: 把淤積、積水與垃圾各自配對責任人及證據。~Assign owners and evidence separately for sediment, ponding and litter.
units.failure: 只完成清掃而不量退水，無法驗證功能恢復。~Cleaning without drawdown measurements cannot verify recovery.
units.misconception: 維護工單勾選完成即可取代性能量測。~A completed work order replaces performance measurement.
units.practice: 在「多目標維護與居民介面」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只完成清掃而不量退水，無法驗證功能恢復。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for maintenance and community interface, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Cleaning without drawdown measurements cannot verify recovery." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

place.coordinateScope: 近似機構所在區域位置；依公開地址作教材地圖代表點，非建物入口、實廠、實測或導航位置。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate institution-area location inferred from its public address for the teaching map; not a building entrance, process plant, surveyed point or navigation coordinate.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
